title: 12 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Northern Alberta Jubilee Auditorium, Edmonton, AB, Canada
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Northern Alberta Jubilee Auditorium in Edmonton, Canada, on 12 October 2015.

It was the 25th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

As you can see the Canadian part of the tour is going really well we are having a lot of fun peace and love ?????? pic.twitter.com/J6U48cjFws

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 13, 2015

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
